teammate_integration: This branch adds material and regressions; it does not contain a newly adopted performance optimization.
Review agent/conversation.json as a whole when integrating: RFC6901 pointers refer to array positions, so blind line-by-line merging can break references.
Preserve truthful student statements, attribution and known limitations; do not combine tier totals or fabricate new units.
Re-run python3 tests/test_agent_material.py and relevant CTest/optimization acceptance after resolving conflicts with your branch.
Review and merge into 2026-competition-round2 only after combined validation; this push does not modify that branch.
